prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with whiplash after a hit while turning left. The patient had 10 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1082; do not mention it.)
text:
The patient was referred to this clinic following a motor vehicle collision in which the patient's vehicle was struck from the side while turning left at an intersection. The patient reported immediate onset of neck pain, stiffness, and headache, consistent with a whiplash-type cervical strain. Initial examination revealed reduced cervical range of motion, particularly with rotation to the right, and paraspinal muscle tenderness with associated muscle guarding. Neurological screening was within normal limits, with no reported radicular symptoms.

Over the course of ten supervised visits, the patient received a combination of manual therapy, soft tissue mobilization, graded cervical range-of-motion exercises, and postural education. Pain levels decreased steadily, and cervical mobility improved to near-normal limits by the final visit. Headache frequency also declined over the treatment period. The patient was instructed in a home exercise program and advised on activity modification.

At discharge, the patient reported residual intermittent neck stiffness with prolonged computer use but no significant functional limitation in daily activities. Continued self-directed exercise and ergonomic adjustments were recommended. Follow-up on an as-needed basis was advised should symptoms recur or worsen.
